quote: AES Andes announced the entry into commercial operation of the second phase of the Virtual Reservoir… The new BESS system will allow the storage of up to 197 MWh of renewable energy produced by the Alfalfal I Hydroelectric Power Plant… Virtual Reservoir II is fitted with Fluence's Gridstack technology. Thanks to this milestone, the company now has 223 MW of storage capacity in operation
note: Opened AES Andes Virtual Reservoir II COD primary (CapEx blank).
